groupDistance.basis: Every member sits at the cluster's distance, the Planck 2018 comoving distance of its MCXC-II redshift 0.3066 (1,257,621,141.76 pc, the Abell 2744 package's own; the query writes it into each row), spread in depth as widely as the members spread across the sky: that the cluster's core is as deep as it is wide is an assumption, not a measurement of any member's depth. The members' own redshifts are not used for depth: inside a cluster they measure motion, not distance.

sample: The 202 galaxies table B1 of Bergamini et al. (2023) marks as spectroscopic cluster members of Abell 2744 (Type = s); its 23 photometric members (Type = p) are left out. All 202 kept.
meaning: Spectroscopically confirmed member galaxies of Abell 2744 from the cluster member catalogue of Bergamini et al. (2023), one dot each at the cluster's distance. Drawn when the cluster is selected.

toneBy.band: HST F160W (AB), the table's mF160W, as observed
toneBy.basis: A display scale, not a rest-frame luminosity: each member's F160W magnitude minus the distance modulus of the comoving distance it is placed at (40.50 mag) darkens its color, from full at -23 to 30% at -18, linear in magnitude. The members run from 16.88 to 23.83 mag, so from -23.6 to -16.7 on this scale. No k-correction is applied and the luminosity-distance modulus is not used; the table gives no type or color, so every dot is white.

fullDetail.basis: Presentation choice: whole within 3,800 Mpc of the Sun, three times the cluster's distance, so every member shows while the cluster is selected and framed (the bank's origin is the Sun; the renderer's default of 10 kpc suits a galaxy's own dots).
